heroHeadline: PMF Splits as Some Militias Disarm, Kataib Hezbollah Refuses; Zaidi Cabinet Still Partial After Three Weeks
heroSubtitle: Iraq's Popular Mobilization Forces have fractured into compliant and hardline blocs: al-Sadr dissolved Saraya al-Salam (May 27), Asaib Ahl al-Haq and Kataib al-Imam Ali pledged weapons transfer to state authority (June 2–3), but Kataib Hezbollah and Nujaba refused outright, demanding full US withdrawal from Kurdistan before any disarmament. PM Zaidi's cabinet remains partial three weeks after formation, with Defense and Interior still vacant. Iraq approved tripling Kirkuk-Ceyhan pipeline exports to 770,000 bpd to partially bypass the Hormuz blockade. The KRG-Baghdad gas contract standoff — over $110B in US energy deals — remains unresolved, with Kurdistan's budget still frozen.
